tools.name: search_icons
tools.description: Use this when someone needs an icon, emoji, or brand mark to use as a favicon or app icon. Searches Iconify and returns ready-to-use prefix:name values plus the generate_iconset options.

tools.name: check_favicon
tools.description: Use this when someone asks whether a website favicon, Apple touch icon, app icons, manifest, or search-result icon is installed correctly. Reads a public website, verifies declared icon files, reports missing coverage, and can check search-engine favicon indexing. It never changes the website.

tools.name: generate_iconset
tools.description: Use this when someone asks to create, replace, or install favicons, website icons, Apple touch icons, PWA icons, or app icons. Generates favicon.ico, PNG sizes, Apple/Android icons, theme-aware icons, manifests, environment variants, downloadable URLs, and an install snippet from one image, URL, or
